faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.help_before: Can't find your question? Feel free to

1.question: Are your iPhones original or refurbished?
1.answer: All our devices are original premium pre-owned Apple products: not refurbished and without replaced parts.

2.question: How is battery health determined?
2.answer: We measure battery capacity with the original Apple diagnostic tools and clearly list this percentage on every product.

3.question: What does the warranty cover?
3.answer: Every device comes with 6 to 12 months of warranty, depending on the product.

4.question: Can I trade in my old device?
4.answer: Sure! Use our trade-in estimator for an indication of the value.

1.title: IMEI and Apple serial number check
1.text: Every device is checked for a valid, non-blocked IMEI and serial number, directly at Apple.

2.title: Official Apple diagnostics
2.text: We run the original Apple diagnostic tools to verify battery health, screen performance and components.

3.title: No uncertified parts
3.text: If anything has ever been replaced, it is done with original Apple parts — never with cheap copies.

4.title: Unique photo report per device
4.text: You see the actual device you buy: no stock photos, but clear photos of its real condition.

5.title: 6–12 months warranty
5.text: If anything does come up, we're there for you personally — with warranty on every device.
